list.name: API Layer
list.description: Provides FastAPI HTTP servers, Model Context Protocol (MCP) bridges, JSON-RPC protocol implementations, and CLI wrappers to expose runtime features to external interfaces.

list.name: Runtime Orchestration Layer
list.description: Coordinates core SeamRuntime subsystems, handles sandbox workspaces, manages memory ingestion pipelines, and drives self-improvement evaluation feedback loops.

list.name: Natural Language & Compiler Layer
list.description: Compiles logs into structured MIRL records, compiles DSL constructs, executes semantic/grounded fact extraction (first-person or multi-speaker), and projects contextual evidence.

list.name: Retrieval Layer
list.description: Implements hybrid multi-modal search and ranking, query planning and merging across vector/lexical/graph adapters, and parses relative temporal query criteria.

list.name: Data & Storage Layer
list.description: Provides low-level SQLite storage, vector stores, knowledge graphs, connection pool management, and optimizes prompt payloads using LX1 encoding and symbols compression.

list.name: User Interface Layer
list.description: Exposes terminal TUI dashboards and progressive web-based console panels to inspect Seam database statistics, configurations, and logs in real-time.

list.name: Skills Framework Layer
list.description: Defines intermediate representations, factories, and validation rules to propose and orchestrate agent-specific skills.

list.name: Infrastructure & Platform Layer
list.description: Provides installers, pgvector container bootstrapping logic, resilience retry decorators, diagnostic doctor scripts, and synchronizes file-based artifact stores.

list.name: Benchmarks & Evaluation Layer
list.description: Evaluates search and compression performance with automated test suites, Git baseline policy routing, integrity signers, and external memory benchmarks.

list.name: Documentation Layer
list.description: Contains technical plans, design patterns, and architecture documentation describing hybrid retrieval strategy and module boundaries.
